Each has five hits at the same moments, near 0, 1.85, 3.65, 4.0 and 5.8 s, and the loudest hit is the last one in both (peakAt 5.83 vs 5.85 s). The energy sits mostly in 600-2k Hz in both (72% vs 77%).

The reproduction's T20 is 0.254 s, outside that range, which caps S2 at 1 even though the harness reports inRange true.
